label: Finite interpretations with two beings and two respects; excluded middle is not asserted
paraphrase: Finite interpretations with two beings and two respects (esse and one further perfection); excluded middle is not asserted. Omitting in turn the cause-of-being transfer, the cause-of-quality comparison, or 'more such has the perfection', with the other two holding, a cause of the being of a thing lacks that thing's further perfection. All three hold together with preexistence in a positive model with a nonvacuous cause.
